item.title: Letter to the Editor: Will AI Replace Teachers?
item.prompt_text: A newspaper recently published an opinion column arguing that artificial intelligence will soon make human teachers unnecessary. Write a letter to the editor responding to the column. Engage seriously with its arguments and present your own position.
item.target_grammar: concessive structures (While it is true that…, Granted…); nuanced hedging and emphasis
item.target_structure: reference to the column + stance + fair concession + counter-arguments + alternative vision + incisive close

checklist.point: Refer to the column and state your position
Fairly acknowledge what the column gets right
Argue what teachers do that AI cannot
Propose a more realistic role for AI in education
End with a sharp, memorable conclusion
